figures.title: Chapter map
figures.why: translational mechanics retold in angular language - mass, force, momentum get rotational twins
figures.read: every result is an analogue pair, a parallel-axis shift, or a no-slip constraint

figures.title: Two axis theorems: shift it or split it
figures.why: almost every inertia calculation is one of two moves
figures.data: parallel I = I_cm + Md²; perpendicular I_z = I_x + I_y
figures.read: parallel axis pushes outward by Md²; perpendicular splits flat-body inertia

figures.title: Torque: force times the lever arm
figures.why: the same force turns harder from farther out
figures.data: τ = rF sinθ moment arm; τ = Iα
figures.read: torque cares about the perpendicular distance to the line of action

figures.title: Angular momentum: constant when torque-free - even as KE changes
figures.why: L is frozen while kinetic energy rises, paid for by internal work
figures.data: L = Iω constant; I halves → ω doubles, K doubles
figures.read: conservation protects the product Iω, not the energy

figures.title: Rolling without slipping: two energies, one race
figures.why: the whole rolling toolkit in one figure
figures.data: v_cm = ωR; K = ½Mv² + ½Iω²; a = g sinθ / (1+I/MR²)
figures.read: rotation eats a share of energy set by I/MR²; smallest share wins

figures.title: Triage - route by the keyword
figures.why: the keyword names the route before any number is touched
figures.read: inertia wants axis theorems, rolling wants no-slip, torque-free words want conservation
